title: Application and Petition of the Cambridge Electric Light Company, pursuant to G.L. Chapter 164, Section 14, for approval and authorization to issue and set up to 56,000 shares of common stock, $25 per share, at no less than par; to issue and sell, on a negotiated basis, additional long-term notes in the aggregate principal amount of up to $15,000,000; for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. Chapter 164, Section 15.
